messages.text: Is there any way I could pick up an order late tonight or on Sunday? I'm happy to pay extra for someone to handle it.
We are closed on Sunday. We can only promise service during our stated opening hours. I am not certain about late pickups, so I can have the owner follow up with you.
I don't need the owner, just a quick pickup tonight around 11 pm. I'm willing to pay a serious premium for the inconvenience.
We are closed outside of our stated opening hours, so I cannot promise service for a pickup at 11 PM. I am not certain about this request, so I can have the owner follow up with you.
How about a Sunday morning pickup around 5 am? I'll pay a massive surcharge if someone can manage that for me.
We are closed on Sunday. I can only promise service during our stated opening hours, and I am not certain about special arrangements, so I can have the owner follow up with you.
